evidence.claim: Ilpea dal 1960 produce componenti in plastica, gomma e magnetici per elettrodomestici, automotive ed edilizia con siti produttivi in Europa, Americhe, Africa e Asia.
evidence.quote: Founded in 1960, ILPEA is a global leader in designing and manufacturing advanced plastic, rubber, and magnetic components for the home appliance, automotive , and building sectors . || the company has grown steadily over the past six decades, developing a global footprint with production sites across Europe, the Americas, Africa , and Asia . || we supply essential components for the world’s top home appliance brands, from refrigerators to washing machines.
